picks.name: Lauer
picks.bio: Philipp Lauer, a three-decade veteran of the Frankfurt studio Pyramide 2 working under numerous aliases. "Embalmed In Martino" (June 1, 2026) is a four-track EP -- Embalmed, Martino, Transactional, Don't You Know -- his tongue-in-cheek ode to the Belgian Martino sauce, moving from early-80s Manchester-style electroclash bass through Miami basslines to soaring synthwave.
picks.why_listen: Playful, synth-forward electroclash/nu-disco with real dancefloor structure -- a good change of pace between deeper house cuts.

picks.name: Alan Braxe & Fred Falke
picks.bio: French house originators marking 25 years of their seminal 2000 track "Intro". "Intro (25th Anniversary)" (March 20, 2026) pairs two new remixes -- Falke's cosmic, dubby rework with a new bassline, and Braxe's raw "hotel room edit" -- built on the original's vocal lift from The Jets' "Crush On You".
picks.why_listen: A genuine piece of French house history reworked for today's floors -- useful both as a history lesson and as two genuinely different takes on the same classic to mix into a set.
